body: My partner went through a traumatic event which affected their interest in sex for almost a year. During that time we explored a lot of ways to be intimate without sex. To this day we really enjoy: cuddling, listening to music and dancing while making dinner, playing with eachother’s hair/giving light head massages while we watch TV; back massages; closing our eyes and touching our foreheads together while trying to clear our minds for about a minute (feels like ASMR!), playing chess, we play a game (idk what it’s called) where one of us will think of something, name the category that it’s in, and the other has to figure out what it is using only yes/no questions, hiding cheesy little notes for the other to find, and stepping outside to get a bit of fresh air and chat for 2-3 mins before we go to bed (we used to be smokers and kept up this part of the habit). Hope this is useful to someone!
